sloka: तद्वाक्यं लक्ष्मण: श्रुत्वा व्रीडित: प्रत्युवाच ह।त्वां मन्ये द्रष्टुमायात: पिता दशरथ: स्वयम् ॥ २.९७.२०॥
transliteration: tadvākyaṁ lakṣmaṇa: śrutvā vrīḍita: pratyuvāca ha।tvāṁ manye draṣṭumāyāta: pitā daśaratha: svayam ॥ 2.97.20॥

translations.english: Hearing the words of Rama, Lakshmana was abashed and said I think it is our father, king Dasaratha who has come here personally to see you.
